ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 0.65:0.35 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark pixels on the visible ventral surface of the right lobe; left lobe ventral surface is primarily occluded by perspective and shadow.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Series of high-contrast dark vertical striations localized to the distal half of the right lobe; contiguous white high-intensity zone occupying the central and medial regions of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped median notch with an approximate angle of 38-42 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Jagged, high-frequency serrations along the superior trailing edge of the right lobe with pixel amplitudes varying significantly; left lobe trailing edge serrations are partially obscured by distal barnacle growth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve originating from the median notch transitioning into a concave sweep toward the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, circular, high-contrast light-colored pixel clusters (barnacle colonies) concentrated along the entire visible lateral margin of the left lobe and the distal tip of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct parallel dark-grey linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented vertically on the white pigmented region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular indentation or missing tissue section on the superior trailing edge of the right lobe, distal to the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy biological encrustation along the lateral perimeters creating a distinct high-relief, beaded texture that modifies the geometric boundary.
